packageRules.description: Automerge patch/minor updates once CI passes (no required checks on this repo, so automerge is gated on the PR's own status checks succeeding)
GitHub Actions updates land in one PR
uv: mise.toml tool pin + ghcr uv builder image in the Dockerfile bump together
Docker base images and compose images in one PR (excludes uv via the rule above)
Dev dependencies (pytest, ruff, ty, poe, semantic-release) in one PR
Runtime Python deps stay individual — they affect the published image
